  "issue": 7247,
  "status": "done",
  "branch": "claude/issue-7247-bar-axis-label-thinning",
  "pr": "https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/7385",
  "premise_still_valid": true,
  "summary": "Premise confirmed on current main and reproduced at the reported widths. Root cause: AdvancedChartImpl's shared xAxisCommonProps applied one tick policy to time and category axes alike (interval 'preserveStartEnd' + minTickGap 48) and keyed it to the VIEWPORT (isMobile), never the widget, so a 174px chart in an 800px console was charged a full desktop inter-label gap; horizontal bars escape only because their category axis is the y axis, which uses recharts' defaults. Fix: a categorical x axis of 5 buckets or fewer now draws every label (interval 0), rotating and ellipsising over-long names; the bound is derived from the narrowest shipped widget (142px plot / rotated labels collide on perpendicular separation bandWidth*sin(35deg) vs a 14px line box => buckets at most 5.8), so nothing is measured at runtime. Above the bound recharts' measured thinning is untouched, which keeps the old 'hundreds of points paint a dense black bar' guard. Change surface declared in the PR body: CHANGED xAxisCommonProps (bar/column, line, area, combo); ALREADY COMPLIANT ChartImpl.tsx (hard-codes interval 0) and the horizontal-bar category axis (both untouched, the latter pinned by a no-regression test); OUT OF SCOPE the scatter axes (#7248, serialized after this card) and the issue's three ride-along polish items. One thing deliberately NOT done here and filed instead: relaxing minTickGap 48 for categorical axes ABOVE the bound (same root cause, but the replacement value is a judgement call and its effect is unmeasurable in happy-dom, which reports zero text metrics).",
  "tests": "All on final commit 200063bc9 (git rev-parse --short HEAD after the last commit). RED FIRST: the new regression test ran against the unfixed source before the policy existed - 5 of 7 failed, e.g. expected ['Green','Red'] to deeply equal ['Green','Yellow','Red'] and expected ['Low','Urgent'] to deeply equal ['Low','Normal','High','Urgent']; the other 2 (high-cardinality thinning, horizontal-bar family) passed both before and after, which is their purpose. Dependency closure built once (pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-charts^...' build, exit 0) before the red run and not rebuilt between red and green; the subject is imported from source, so both runs read the same tree. GREEN: pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/ -> 'Test Files 41 passed (41)' / 'Tests 383 passed (383)'. pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check -> exit 0 with 'tsc --noEmit' echoed (real run, not a zero-match filter); tsc --listFiles confirms the new test file IS in the type-check file set (1 hit), so its green covers the test too. pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts lint -> exit 0, '303 problems (0 errors, 303 warnings)', all pre-existing. check-control-bytes 'OK (scanned 6044 tracked text file(s))'; check-vi-mock-specifiers OK; check-vi-mock-inherit OK (this PR adds a vi.mock('recharts')); check-changeset-fixed OK; check-changeset-no-major OK. Exit codes were captured after redirect to a file, never through a pipe. BROWSER before/after, Chromium at an 800px viewport, plot box 174px, counted from the DOM: Projects by Health 3 bars 1 label -> 3; Tasks by Status 5 bars 2 labels -> 5; Tasks by Priority 4 bars 2 labels -> 4; Hours by Status horizontal 5 -> 5 unchanged; 654px report chart 3 -> 3 unchanged. The BEFORE column reproduces the issue's table exactly. That before-pass used the sanctioned mutate-then-restore shape (fix committed first): mutation 'git checkout origin/main -- FILE' confirmed on disk by blob hash 2acc581d3 -> aceb44fcb plus a zero count of the new policy identifier; restore 'git checkout HEAD -- FILE' proven by the on-disk hash matching the HEAD blob exactly and 'git diff HEAD' empty. DECLARED NARROWINGS/DEVIATIONS (all also in the PR body): (1) os-verify-lock.sh found no usable flock on this macOS host and ran in DECLARED UNLOCKED MODE - nothing was serialized against sibling agents; (2) the dispatched command 'pnpm --filter PKG exec vitest run FILE' is REFUSED by this repo's invocation guard (objectui#3378) because a package-cwd run silently executes @object-ui/console's 22 files and reports them green, so every run was started from the repository root, as CI does; (3) lint here is 'turbo run lint' i.e. a per-package 'eslint .', and this diff touches exactly one package, so the package lint run is the whole lint surface rather than a narrowing.
